descriptionHtml:
**Arctic MX-6 4g Thermal Paste (Original)**

**Brand:** Arctic
**Model:** MX-6
**Size:** 4 grams
**Type:** Non-electrically conductive thermal compound

---

**Technical Specifications:**
- **Thermal Conductivity:** 10.5 W/mK
- **Viscosity:** 50,000 Poise
- **Density:** 2.60 g/cm³
- **Operating Temperature:** -50°C to +150°C

---

**Electrical Properties:**
- **Electrical Conductivity:** No (non-conductive)
- **Capacitance:** Non-capacitive

---

**Application:**
- **Cure Time:** 0 hours (no curing required)
- **Application Method:** Dot method or thin line
- **Color:** Dark grey

---

**Composition:**
- Carbon microparticles
- Metal-free

---

**Features:**
- 100% safe for electronic components (no short circuit risk)
- No curing or drying time needed
- Easy to apply and remove
- Excellent long-term stability
- Superior thermal performance compared to MX-4
- High pump-out resistance

---

**Compatible with:**
- CPUs (Intel / AMD)
- GPUs (NVIDIA / AMD)
- Gaming consoles (PlayStation, Xbox)
- Laptops
- Cooling systems (air and liquid)

---

**Package includes:**
- Arctic MX-6 thermal paste (4g)

---


---

**Performance Notes:**
- Consistent performance across full temperature range
- Suitable for daily use and overclocking
- Noticeable thermal improvement over MX-4
